windows.tiempo: The operation exceeded 20 minutes. Check with “podman machine list” that the Podman machine is still running and try again.
windows.motor_fallo: Operation {0} failed (code {1}). Inspect the etf-windows containers with “podman ps --all”. If updating, keep your private folder and ask IT for help.
windows.privacidad: The password files could not be protected. Installation has stopped.
windows.fuera_paquete: The private folder must be outside the extracted package folder.
windows.windows: You need 64-bit Windows 10 version 2004 or later, or Windows 11. See LEEME.md.
windows.memoria: The PC needs at least 8 GB of memory. Close other applications or use another PC.
windows.disco: You need at least 15 GB of free space on your Windows profile drive.
windows.wsl: WSL2 is not ready. Run instalar.cmd from the package: it installs WSL2 and tells you if Windows needs to restart.
windows.podman: Podman was not found. Run instalar.cmd from the package: it installs Podman without asking for administrator rights.
windows.maquina: No Podman WSL machine is running. Run instalar.cmd from the package to create or start it.
windows.rootful: The Podman machine must use administrator (rootful) mode. Follow plan B in LEEME.md to turn it on.
windows.rancher: Rancher Desktop must be installed and running with Moby and the rancher-desktop context. See LEEME.md.
windows.suma: A package file is missing or has changed. Download and extract the complete ZIP again. Keep your private folder.
windows.imagenes: Loading the included images. The first run may take several minutes.
windows.arranque: Preparing the database and starting the application. Wait without closing this window.
windows.salud: The application did not start within five minutes. Inspect the etf-windows containers with “podman ps --all”.

windows.listo: The application is ready at {0}. Your test usernames and passwords are in {1}.
windows.sin_instalacion: No previous installation was found. Run instalar.cmd from the complete package.
windows.parado: Application stopped. Your test data is preserved. Reopen Expedientes ETF from the desktop or Start menu, or run instalar.cmd.
windows.actualizado: Update complete. Test data and accounts have been preserved.
windows.borrar_pregunta: ALL data and accounts in this demonstration will be deleted. Other applications are unaffected. Type BORRAR and press Enter to proceed, or just press Enter to cancel
windows.cancelado: Operation cancelled. Your data is preserved.
windows.motor_local: This test can only use the local PC engine. Close the window and ask IT to remove the configured remote connection.
windows.acceso_descripcion: Open Expedientes ETF in its own window.
windows.accesos_listos: Shortcuts created on the desktop and in the Start menu. You can reopen the application from them after stopping it.
windows.acceso_ocupado: A shortcut with this name belongs to another installation. Keep it and ask IT for help.
windows.navegador: Microsoft Edge and Google Chrome were not found. Install either browser and reopen the application.
windows.abrir_error: The application could not restart. Open the container application, start its machine and run instalar.cmd to see the help message.
windows.desinstalar_pregunta: All data and shortcuts for this demonstration will be deleted. Type DESINSTALAR and press Enter to proceed, or just press Enter to cancel
windows.desinstalado: Demonstration uninstalled. Its data and shortcuts have been removed. Unrelated files are preserved and the container application is still installed.
windows.directorio_ajeno: Choose a new folder for this demonstration. The selected folder contains another application’s files or links to another location.
windows.tuberia_reintento: Podman has started its machine but has not opened the connection used by Compose. The Podman machine will be restarted; please wait and keep this window open.
windows.tuberia_proxy: The connection is still closed. Opening it with Podman’s win-sshproxy program.
windows.tuberia: Podman has not opened the connection used by Compose. If Podman Desktop is open, close it. Stop the machine with “podman machine stop”, start it with “podman machine start” and open the application again. If nothing changes, restart Windows or ask IT for help with this message.
windows.antivirus_espera: Waiting for the antivirus to finish loading its signatures. The first time this can take a few minutes.
windows.antivirus: The antivirus has not responded within five minutes. Check the clamav container in etf-windows with “podman ps --all” and open the application again.
windows.requisitos_preparando: Checking what the application needs on this PC. Anything missing is installed now.
windows.wsl_instalando: Installing WSL2, the Windows component that runs the containers. Windows will ask for administrator permission: click Yes. This can take several minutes.
windows.uac_rechazado: WSL2 was not installed because administrator permission was not granted. Run instalar.cmd again and click Yes when Windows asks. If your account does not have that permission, ask IT to install WSL2 (plan B in LEEME.md).
windows.wsl_fallo: WSL2 could not be installed ({0}). If Windows says virtualization is turned off, ask IT to turn it on. You can also follow plan B in LEEME.md.
windows.reiniciar: WSL2 is installed, but Windows must restart to turn it on. Save your work and restart the PC. When you sign in again, the installation continues by itself in a new window.
windows.wsl_sin_activar: Windows has restarted and WSL2 still does not work. This usually happens when virtualization is turned off on the PC. Ask IT to turn it on and run instalar.cmd again.
windows.podman_instalando: Installing Podman, the program that runs the application containers. It is installed for your user only and does not ask for administrator rights.
windows.podman_fallo: Podman could not be installed (code {0}). If another program is being installed, wait until it finishes and run instalar.cmd again. If it happens again, ask IT for help and give them the log {1}.
windows.maquina_creando: Creating the Podman machine with 4 GB of memory and 2 processors. Podman downloads its system the first time; this can take several minutes.
windows.compose_instalando: Preparing Compose, the tool that starts all the application components together.
windows.compose: Podman cannot find Compose. Run instalar.cmd again from the complete package. If nothing changes, ask IT for help with this message.
windows.maquina_esperando: Podman is starting its machine, for example because Podman Desktop opened when you signed in. Waiting for it to finish, up to 3 minutes. Do not close this window.
windows.maquina_arrancando: The Podman machine has been starting for more than 3 minutes. Wait until Podman Desktop shows it as running and open the application again. If nothing changes, restart Windows or ask IT for help with this message.
windows.abrir_registro: IT can find the details in {0}. That file contains no passwords.
windows.maquina_apagando: Stopping the Podman machine so that Windows can shut down or restart without waiting.
windows.maquina_en_uso: The Podman machine is still running because it has containers from other applications. Before shutting down or restarting Windows, stop it from Podman Desktop or with “podman machine stop”.
windows.maquina_no_apagada: The Podman machine did not stop within 2 minutes. Before shutting down or restarting Windows, stop it from Podman Desktop or with “podman machine stop”.
windows.quitar_podman_pregunta: This demo installed Podman and its machine on this PC. If you do not use them for anything else, type QUITAR and press Enter to uninstall them too. Press Enter without typing anything to keep them
windows.quitar_maquina_pregunta: This demo created the Podman machine. If you do not use it for anything else, type QUITAR and press Enter to delete it. Podman is kept. Press Enter without typing anything to keep it
windows.requisitos_conservados: Podman and its machine have been kept.
windows.requisitos_en_uso: The Podman machine has containers from other applications or is not responding, so neither Podman nor its machine is removed. You can remove them later as described in LEEME.md.
windows.maquina_quitando: Deleting the Podman machine created by this demo.
windows.maquina_quitar_fallo: The Podman machine could not be deleted. Podman has been kept so that you can delete it with “podman machine rm”. See LEEME.md.
windows.podman_quitando: Uninstalling Podman, which this demo installed.
windows.podman_quitar_fallo: Podman could not be uninstalled (code {0}). Remove it from Settings > Apps. If it is not listed, ask IT for help and provide the log {1}.
windows.podman_quitar_manual: The Podman installation code is unknown. If you want to remove it, do so from Settings > Apps.
windows.wsl_conservado: WSL2 has been kept because Windows and other applications may use it. To remove it, follow the section “Qué instala y cómo quitarlo” in LEEME.md.
windows.instalador_bienvenida_titulo: Install the Expedientes ETF test version
windows.instalador_bienvenida_texto:
This wizard copies the test application to your Windows account. It does not ask for administrator permission.

If it is already installed, it updates it and keeps your data.

When it finishes, a black window opens that installs anything missing (WSL2 and Podman), prepares the made-up data and opens the application. It takes a few minutes. Do not close it until it finishes.
windows.instalador_fin_texto:
A black window has opened to finish the installation. Follow its instructions and wait for the application to open.

To remove it later, go to Settings > Apps and look for Expedientes ETF.
windows.instalador_consola: Opening the window that finishes the installation…
windows.instalador_ajeno: Cannot install: the folder %LOCALAPPDATA%\Expedientes-ETF\pruebas contains another application's files. Move them to another folder and open the installer again.
windows.instalador_desinstalar_aviso: A black window will open and ask you to confirm before the test data is deleted.
windows.instalador_desinstalar_cancelado: Expedientes ETF is still installed. If you cancelled, there is nothing to do. If the window showed an error, read it and try again.
